[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Shemza''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], who was an old [[Gender/Legends|man]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tried to capture Shemza, as the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] believed that he could use Shemza's knowledge against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. After hiding for many months, Shemza was able to make contact with the Rebel Alliance and through a [[Shemza's Rebel contact|contact]], he was able to arrange a rendezvous with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]]. However, while he waited on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], he was attacked by a group of thugs who had been hired by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to capture him and take him back to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The thugs tricked Shemza's Rebel contact into leaving Shemza and then took him. However, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were passing through and after they heard Shemza's plea for help, they attacked the thugs and tried to free him.
